paragraphs.text: Many cities are replacing diesel buses with electric ones. Electric buses are quieter and produce no exhaust fumes in the street, which improves air quality where people walk and wait.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The main drawback has been range. Early models could travel only about 150 kilometres before recharging, which was not enough for a full day’s service. Newer buses carry larger batteries, but these are heavy and reduce the number of passengers the bus can carry.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Some cities avoid large batteries by charging buses briefly at the end of each route, using equipment mounted above the bus stop. A few minutes of charging is enough for the next journey.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Although electric buses cost more to buy, operators report that they are cheaper to run, because electricity costs less than diesel and the motors need less maintenance.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Several manufacturers now offer buses that can be fitted with extra batteries for longer journeys, so operators can choose the design that suits each part of the city.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: produce no exhaust fumes in the street

explanation.en: “produce no exhaust fumes” → fumes, letter C. B (noise) is a trap: the buses are quieter, not silent, and the summary is about clean air.
explanation.kk: «produce no exhaust fumes» → fumes, яғни C әрпі. B (noise) — тұзақ: автобус тыныш, бірақ шу бар, ал түйін ауа тазалығы туралы.
explanation.ru: «produce no exhaust fumes» → fumes, буква C. B (noise) — ловушка: автобусы тише, но шум есть, а пересказ говорит о чистоте воздуха.

items.quote: The main drawback has been range.

explanation.en: “The main drawback has been range” — early models managed about 150 km → range, letter F.
explanation.kk: «The main drawback has been range» — алғашқы модельдер шамамен 150 км жүрген → range, яғни F әрпі.
explanation.ru: «The main drawback has been range» — первые модели проезжали около 150 км → range, буква F.

items.quote: reduce the number of passengers the bus can carry

explanation.en: “reduce the number of passengers the bus can carry” means capacity → G. The word is not in the text: the list tests understanding of the paraphrase.
explanation.kk: «reduce the number of passengers the bus can carry» — бұл сыйымдылық → capacity, яғни G әрпі. Мәтінде capacity сөзі жоқ: тізім түйінді түсінуді тексереді.
explanation.ru: «reduce the number of passengers the bus can carry» — это вместимость → capacity, буква G. Слова capacity в тексте нет: список проверяет понимание пересказа.

items.quote: charging buses briefly at the end of each route

explanation.en: “charging buses briefly at the end of each route” → route, letter A.
explanation.kk: «charging buses briefly at the end of each route» — әр бағыттың соңында зарядтайды → route, яғни A әрпі.
explanation.ru: «charging buses briefly at the end of each route» → route, буква A.

explanation.en: “the motors need less maintenance” → maintenance, letter D. H (price) is a trap: they cost more to buy.
explanation.kk: «the motors need less maintenance» → maintenance, яғни D әрпі. H (price) — тұзақ: сатып алу, керісінше, қымбатырақ.
explanation.ru: «the motors need less maintenance» → maintenance, буква D. H (price) — ловушка: купить их как раз дороже.
